_comment: Curated publish titles (YouTube title + thumbnail header) per course, keyed by course id. Search-first: what someone would actually type into YouTube, never 'Course 4'. One entry per course in src/content/index.ts. Read by @graphlearning/shell's gen-descriptions and thumb scripts; the single full-course film sets its own title in scripts/film.mjs.
intro: What Linux actually is: the kernel, the distribution, and the server we'll build
shell: The Linux shell for beginners: ssh, paths, files, and reading the manual
packages: apt explained: installing nginx and keeping a Debian server updated
text: Linux text tools: pipes, grep, sed and awk on a real nginx log
users: Linux users, groups, file permissions and sudo, explained properly
processes: Linux processes: ps, top, signals, and stopping a runaway program
services: systemd explained: systemctl, unit files, journalctl and timers
network: Linux networking: ports, DNS, SSH keys, nftables firewall and HTTPS
storage: Linux storage: partitions, filesystems, fstab, a full disk, and backups
scripting: Bash scripting for sysadmins: a real deploy script, from first line to timer
rhel: Rocky Linux vs Debian: dnf, firewalld and SELinux for Red Hat beginners
